rv.q: The best thing about this revival is that it reminds us of what a good play 'American Buffalo' really is, and how effectively it can work when performed by actors who understand that Mr. Mamet's tough-guy dialogue is a kind of music that must be played with absolute precision.
But Robert Falls’ production drains much of the humor, urgency and anxiety from the piece, letting it amble along like an inflated actors’ exercise in sustaining atmosphere without action.
Cedric the Entertainer brings surprising depth and nuance to his role as Walter 'Teach' Cole, while Haley Joel Osment makes a solid Broadway debut as the young Bobby.

John Leguizamo, Cedric the Entertainer, and Haley Joel Osment have been cast in roles that, quite simply, don't suit them, and David Mamet's potent 1975 drama about three small-time crooks planning a coin heist suffers considerably as a result.
